title: Domestic disturbance with arrest and force
narrative: I responded to 142 Oak Street at about 2:15 AM for a domestic disturbance. A female victim was standing at the doorway with redness on her forearm. The male subject ignored commands, pulled away when I attempted to detain him, and I used a control hold to place him in handcuffs. He was arrested for domestic battery and resisting arrest.

title: Traffic stop with DUI arrest
narrative: I stopped a blue Honda Civic for drifting across lanes near Pine and 8th at 11:40 PM. The driver had watery eyes, slurred speech, and smelled of alcohol. After field sobriety tests, I arrested the driver for DUI.

title: Simple theft report
narrative: I took a theft report from a store manager at 500 Market Street. The manager reported that a suspect concealed headphones and left without paying. No arrest was made at the scene.
